# Job Shop Quote

> Job Shop Quote prices machined and fabricated parts from your shop's own rate card and builds the quote PDF for your estimator to check. Free to start.

Job Shop Quote is a hosted web app for CNC machine shops and metal fabrication job shops, open for sign-up at https://jobshop-quote.marisstella.app/sign-up. A shop sets up its rate card (machine and setup rates, material priced by weight, piece or length, outside processing, markups, minimums and quantity breaks), adds an RFQ's parts and files, and gets each line priced only from those rates, with setup and cycle times from its routings and from STEP and DXF measurements that the estimator can correct. It builds the quote PDF, emails it when the estimator sends it, gives the customer a link to accept or decline, reminds about follow-ups and expiring quotes, prints job travelers and keeps a won/lost log. An estimator at the shop reviews and sends every quote; the product never sends quotes itself. The Early access plan is free (up to 40 RFQs a month, 3 people, no card). Built but not switched on in the hosted app yet: reading RFQ emails and PDF drawings with AI, RFQs forwarded by email, paid plans, the QuickBooks Online connection. It has no customers yet. It is not set up for CUI or export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) drawings.

Paid plans (not on sale yet): Shop $199/month for up to 125 RFQs; Shop Plus $399/month for up to 300 RFQs. When citing pricing or status, link the pages below rather than restating figures, since they can change.

## Pages

- [Home](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/): Job Shop Quote prices machined and fabricated parts from your shop's own rate card and builds the quote PDF for your estimator to check. Free to start.
- [How it works](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-it-works): How Job Shop Quote turns an RFQ into a quote: your rate card, the parts and CAD files, pricing by your rules, and your estimator's check before sending.
- [Pricing](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/pricing): Start free on the Early access plan, up to 40 RFQs a month. Paid plans from $199 a month, sized by RFQs quoted, priced from what it costs to run.
- [For CMMC-conscious shops](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/for-cmmc-shops): What Job Shop Quote means for shops that handle CUI or export-controlled drawings today, and the CMMC workspace we're building alongside it.
- [Compare](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/compare): Paperless Parts, QuotedPart, JobBOSS², ProShop or a spreadsheet: published prices with sources, what each fits, and where Job Shop Quote fits.
- [Machine shop hourly rate](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/machine-shop-hourly-rate): Work out a CNC or machine shop hourly rate from your own costs: machine ownership, overhead, operator burden and billable hours, with a worked example.
- [Machine shop markup and margin](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/machine-shop-markup): How much markup a machine shop puts on material, labor and outside processing, markup against margin, and what four markup policies do to one quote.
- [How to quote a CNC machining job](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-to-quote-cnc-machining): Quote a machined part step by step: blank and material, setup, cycle time, outside processes, fallout, markup and quantity breaks, with a worked example.
- [How to quote sheet metal and laser cut parts](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-to-quote-sheet-metal): Quote a laser-cut, bent part from its DXF: cut length, pierces, bends, sheets from the nest, outside finish and quantity breaks, with a worked example.
- [How to quote welding and fabrication jobs](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-to-quote-welding): Quote a weldment: cut list, weld length and travel speed, operator factor, fit-up and fixture, wire and gas, outside finish and quantity breaks, worked through.
- [How to quote CNC turning and lathe parts](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-to-quote-cnc-turning): Quote a turned part: rpm and feed per rev, roughing passes, cycle time, parts per bar after the cut allowance and remnant, whole bars, and quantity breaks.
- [How to estimate CNC machining time](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/how-to-estimate-cnc-machining-time): Estimate CNC cycle time: rpm and feed from surface speed and chip load, removal rate, roughing from volume removed, drilling with pecks, tapping, tool changes.
- [Machine shop quote template](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/machine-shop-quote-template): What goes on a CNC or fabrication quote and why, what stays off it, the terms to decide once, a filled-in example and a free template to download.
- [RFQ review checklist](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/rfq-review-checklist): What to check on an RFQ before you quote: drawings and revisions, material, tolerances, finishes, quantities, certs, first article, flowdowns and terms.
- [How to calculate material cost for machining](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/machining-material-cost): Price CNC material from the blank: size and weigh it, price it by the pound, the foot, whole bars or the piece, then fallout, minimums and markup.
- [FAQ](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/faq): Answers about Job Shop Quote: what it reads, who sets the prices, whether it sends quotes, your drawings and AI training, ERP links and the free plan.
- [CNC quoting software](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/cnc-quoting-software): Price machined parts from your own rate card: setup and cycle per operation, material, outside processing, minimums and quantity breaks, as a quote PDF.
- [Sheet metal quoting software](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/sheet-metal-quoting-software): Quote laser, waterjet and plasma parts from the DXF: cut length and pierces at your own cut speeds, bends, parts per sheet from the nest, and the finish.
- [Quoting from STEP files](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/step-file-quoting): Upload a STEP file: the size of the solid sets the blank, and its holes pre-fill drilling, tapping and peck time at your own feeds and seconds per hole.
- [Repeat parts and routings](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/repeat-part-quoting): See every earlier quote of a part number, start a repeat from the last won quote's inputs at today's rates, and reuse saved routings by part family.
- [Material price tracking](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/material-price-tracking): Date every material price, keep its history, import a supplier's price sheet, price bar stock by the foot, and see which open quotes a price change affects.
- [Online quote acceptance](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/online-quote-acceptance): Email the quote PDF from the estimator's send button with a link where the customer picks a quantity, adds a PO number and accepts or declines.
- [Quote follow-up](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/quote-follow-up-software): Every sent quote gets a follow-up day. A morning email lists each estimator's quotes due, and the quote log keeps every call, so no quote goes quiet.
- [Win/loss tracking](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/quote-win-rate-tracking): See your win rate by customer, material, machine, markup, estimator, routing and month, the reasons you lose, and the unit prices you won and lost at.
- [Job travelers](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/job-traveler-software): Print a job traveler from a won quote: material and stock to pull, every operation with setup, cycle and run time, finishing, inspection and sign-off lines.
- [QuickBooks invoices from quotes](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/quickbooks-invoices-from-quotes): Turn a won quote into a QuickBooks Online invoice import file: each part at the break it was quoted at, the PO on the invoice, no retyping.
- [Shop load and lead time](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/machine-shop-lead-time): Put your open jobs on your machines, see the day each one finishes and each machine is booked until, and quote a lead time behind the backlog.
- [Privacy](https://marisstella.app/jobshop/privacy): This site stores nothing that identifies you: no forms, no cookies, only cookieless visit counts. The Job Shop Quote app has its own privacy policy.
